dialogues.speaker: Waranka
dialogues.text: ...Strange footfalls. Are you guests from afar?

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: So, you know the kid... Are you the travelers from abroad he mentioned? I hope he didn't cause you too much trouble, and that you won't hold it against him.

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: Without his mother around to keep him in check, he's quite a bit more mischievous than most kids. As for me... I have my difficulties, which limit what I can do for him.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He seems to really want to help you.

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: Yes, yes, so I've heard. Perhaps I'm the one in the wrong... When I think of how his mother is gone, I tell him stories to drive his loneliness away...

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: But I never expected him to believe them, and try to use magic to bring his mother back... *sigh* Should I wake him up from his fantasies? I just don't know what to do...

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: Thanks for the compliment, but that's a skill I've honed due to my other deficiencies... Maybe it would be better if I hadn't.

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: If you're an adventurer, be very careful of the "Gem Collector," lest you end up like me.

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: He's a fiendish, vicious villain. The "gems" he loves are not those beloved of the Children of Echoes' artisans... Anyway, keep your guard up around him.

response.speaker: Waranka
response.text: I wish you all the best.
